reason: The trigger is confirmed against the company release (isomorphiclabs.com press / PR Newswire 302769674, 12 May 2026): a $2.1B Series B led by Thrive Capital with existing backers Alphabet and GV and new investors MGX, Temasek, CapitalG and the UK Sovereign AI Fund, to scale the IsoDDE drug-design engine and take the first internal candidates towards the clinic. Two items in the thin row are wrong: no chief marketing officer was hired (the 2026 leadership change is Max Jaderberg to President from 1 Jan 2026; the 'CMO' the row picked up was Dr Ben Wolf, Chief Medical Officer, June 2025), and no headcount-expansion announcement was found. The case does not clear the bar and would score in the low 50s, below the 70 threshold: Isomorphic is a London-based, Alphabet-controlled AI drug-design lab whose capital is earmarked for R&D and clinical programmes, whose audiences are pharma partners (Novartis, Lilly, J&J) and AI talent, and whose leadership (CEO Sir Demis Hassabis, President Max Jaderberg, COO Pamela Carroll, CSO Miles Congreve, CTO Sergei Yakneen) lists no CMO or commercial-marketing owner, so there is no sponsorship decision path; there is no operational workstream a race team would use, only a halo; and Alphabet already occupies F1 through Google's McLaren partnership (Google/Chrome, Android, Gemini, Google Cloud on the McLaren roster in the sponsor table), so an Alphabet-family brand on any other car is implausible and on McLaren it is Google's lane, not Isomorphic's. No motorsport tie found for any leader. Screened; re-open only if Isomorphic builds a commercial-marketing function or Alphabet's F1 posture changes.
